ideas.pitch: A choice-driven narrative game built with Ren'Py that incorporates a modular story structure, specifically engineered to dynamically swap out chapters and sub-plots based on a surprise late-stage prompt twist.
ideas.title: TwistEngine: Adaptive Narrative Visual Novel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core format of Cognition GameJam 2026 where shortlisted teams must adapt their prototype to a surprise theme reveal in the final round.

ideas.pitch: A 2D Unity platformer designed with highly decoupled mechanic components, allowing the team to quickly toggle gravity, movement speed, or combat rules when the surprise twist is announced.
ideas.title: Echoes of Incarnia: Modular 2D Platformer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages robust technical implementation and execution, which are explicitly listed as the primary evaluation criteria for Round 1 prototype submissions.

ideas.pitch: A puzzle game where the core rules of physics change dynamically mid-level based on text prompts or conditional triggers, built to easily integrate new rule sets introduced during the jam's final twist.
ideas.title: PromptShift: The Live-Modifying Puzzle Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high technical agility and creative problem-solving under real-world development constraints, impressing judges looking for adaptable game architectures.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight 2D fighting game prototype featuring simple rule-based AI agents that can automatically adjust their combat behavior when new environmental hazards are dynamically spawned onto the stage.
ideas.title: AgentArena: Autonomous NPC Duelist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by implementing autonomous agent logic within a tight 36-hour timeframe, standing out among traditional manual gameplay submissions.

ideas.pitch: A mini RPG prototype featuring a custom local plugin that allows players to chat with NPC characters in real-time, instantly altering quest lines when new narrative constraints drop.
ideas.title: LoreWeaver: Real-Time Dialogue Modifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live, working demonstration of interactive narrative tech that guarantees a memorable judges' presentation during the final round.
